build: release all features x86_64-unknown-linux-musl; opt-level 3, LTO, codegen-units 1

profile.path: private namespaces; IPv6 UDP loopback underlay; IPv4 UDP on VLAN upper interfaces
profile.tags: 802.1Q VID 7, or outer 802.1ad VID 42 plus inner VID 7

notes: One sequential before/after pair per tag depth, each with paced and unlimited traffic. No own build or other test ran concurrently.
Configured outer size is an experimental control, not PMTU evidence. Runtime discovery remains required.
Goodput excludes receiver drain; missing rates include final drain. SKB drop counters do not equal logical frame losses.
Per-core ticks cover CPUs 0-19; worker, socket, TAP and receiver counters are retained.
